flashcards.front: What is the difference between COPY and ADD in Dockerfile?
flashcards.back: COPY copies files from host to container. ADD also supports URLs and auto-extracts tar files. Use COPY unless you need ADD's extras.
Using multiple FROM statements to build in one stage and copy only the final binary to a slim runtime stage. Reduces image size dramatically.
Starts all services defined in docker-compose.yml in detached mode (background). Creates containers, networks, and volumes as defined.
A command that Docker runs periodically to check if the container is healthy. Unhealthy containers can be restarted or have traffic routed away.
